shortDescription: Government-backed 15-year tax-free savings scheme offering EEE status.
longDescription: PPF is one of India's safest investment options with Guaranteed interest (7.1% p.a.), exempt-exempt-exempt (EEE) tax benefit under Section 80C.
benefit: Tax deduction under Sec 80C up to ₹1,50,000 + 100% Tax-Free Interest & Maturity.

conditions.description: Must be an Indian Resident Individual.
Adult individual (or parent on behalf of minor).

shortDescription: Government-sponsored pension scheme offering additional ₹50,000 tax deduction under 80CCD(1B).
longDescription: NPS offers market-linked returns across equity and debt, with dedicated pension wealth accumulation and an exclusive deduction over and above Section 80C.
benefit: Exclusive ₹50,000 tax deduction under 80CCD(1B) + 80CCD(1) benefit up to 10% of salary.

conditions.description: Citizen of India aged between 18 and 70 years.

shortDescription: High-interest tax-free deposit scheme for parents of a girl child below 10 years.
longDescription: SSY provides an attractive interest rate (8.2% p.a.) for securing the higher education and marriage expenses of a girl child, with Section 80C tax deduction.
officialSource: Ministry of Finance / Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
benefit: Section 80C deduction up to ₹1.5L + High Guaranteed Tax-Free Returns (8.2% p.a.).

conditions.description: Parent or legal guardian of a girl child.
Girl child age is 10 years or younger at account opening.

shortDescription: High-yield quarterly income scheme for individuals aged 60 and above.
longDescription: SCSS offers senior citizens a secure 8.2% p.a. quarterly interest income, with principal tax exemption under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 Lakhs.
officialSource: Department of Economic Affairs / India Post
benefit: Guaranteed 8.2% p.a. quarterly payouts + Section 80C deduction up to ₹1.5 Lakhs.

conditions.description: Must be a senior citizen aged 60 years or above (or 55+ for retired defense/VRS employees).

shortDescription: 2-year small savings scheme for women and girls offering 7.5% fixed interest.
longDescription: A government-backed 2-year deposit facility offering a fixed interest rate of 7.5% per annum compounded quarterly for female investors.
benefit: Fixed guaranteed 7.5% p.a. returns over 2 years with partial withdrawal flexibility.

conditions.description: Account holder must be a woman or a girl child (by guardian).

shortDescription: Guaranteed monthly pension scheme (₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month) for citizens in unorganized sectors.
longDescription: Government guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 40 offering lifelong monthly pension after age 60.
benefit: Government guaranteed monthly pension of up to ₹5,000/month after 60 + Tax benefits under 80CCD.

conditions.description: Subscriber is not an income tax payer (eligible for non-income tax paying individuals).
